text: TotalEnergies SE's shares are quoted in Paris, Brussels, London and New York. Euronext determines a 95% free-float factor for it in the CAC 40, and its 2025 Shareholders' Guide puts 76.5% of shares with institutional shareholders, 15.3% with individuals and 8.2% with employees.

source.name: TotalEnergies: Shareholders' Guide 2025, 'The TotalEnergies share' (shareholding structure as at December 31, 2024)
source.quote: Free float factor determined by Euronext (CAC 40): 95%

additionalSources.name: TotalEnergies SE Annual Report on Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR), Item 9 'The offer and listing'
additionalSources.quote: The main trading markets for the TotalEnergies shares are the following: Euronext Paris (France) and the New York Stock Exchange
additionalSources.note: Filed with the SEC on 27 March 2026; confirms the listing on Euronext Paris, the NYSE, Euronext Brussels and the London Stock Exchange. EDGAR blocks automated source checks (403); opened manually.
